title: TCG:LGS-095

power.text:
If Scheming Professor is KO'd, put him in zone 5.

On the defending players turn, roll a 6-sided die. 1: Move Archwarder 1 zone forward. 2: Move Archwarder 2 zones forward. 3: move Scheming Trapfeaster 1 zone forward. 4: move Scheming Trapfeaster 2 zones forward. 5: Move Scheming Nordrake 1 zone forward. 6: Move Scheming Professor 1 zone forward.
